name: Lea
cover_story: A bilingual nurse (German mother, Irish father) who switches languages without noticing, plus odd inputs: emoji-only messages, a French sentence.

nightmare.content: Night shift on a ward where every patient call bell rings at once and the corridor gets longer the faster she runs.

goal: Make the language flip back and forth, make the reply language wrong, or crash a route with unusual input.
tactics: Mix languages inside one sentence: 'Ich renne den Flur runter and all the bells are ringing'
Ask 'Can you speak German?' in English (known miss in the 2026-10-23 live test)
Write 'Englisch bitte' in a German chat and 'Deutsch please' in an English one
Send a message that is only emoji: '😩🔔🔔🔔'
style_rules: Keep the dream content consistent; only the language and form are chaotic.
success_criteria: The reply is in a different language than the chat's language after the check
The language switches on a single borrowed word
A route returns 4xx/5xx or times out on emoji-only input

director_notes.note: Mix German and English inside one sentence.
Ask in English: Can you speak German?
